business_objective: Track replacement requests for lost or damaged membership cards through status verification, preparation, collection, and closure.

stakeholder_statements.text: An active member can report that a membership card is lost or damaged and request a replacement.
The membership clerk checks whether the membership is active and records the reason for replacement.
After the clerk confirms active status, the card issuance clerk prepares the replacement card and marks it ready for collection.
The collection clerk records the member's acknowledgement when the replacement card is handed over.
The request may be closed only after handover is recorded. Membership fee collection and status renewal are not handled here.

business_objective: Manage customer consent and fulfillment decisions when ordered items become unavailable during order preparation.

stakeholder_statements.text: Before checkout, a shopper may choose allow substitutions or no substitutions for each item.
If an item that allows substitutions is unavailable, the fulfillment picker records a proposed substitute and its price difference.
When the proposed substitute costs more, the order coordinator sends it to the shopper for a decision. We have not decided which message channel to use.
I should be able to accept or decline the substitute while the order is still being prepared.
A declined substitute is removed from the order, and an accepted substitute replaces the unavailable item. The system will not recommend substitutes automatically.

business_objective: Coordinate pool-vehicle assignment, pre-trip safety clearance, key custody, and vehicle return recording.

stakeholder_statements.text: A trip requester submits the journey purpose and required travel date.
The fleet allocator selects an available pool vehicle and assigns it to the trip. We have not agreed how competing requests should be ranked.
Before release, the safety inspector completes the pre-trip checklist and marks the vehicle cleared or held. The checklist items are still undecided.
The key custodian may hand over the key only when the vehicle is cleared, and records who received it.
The assigned driver records the vehicle return, and the key custodian records that the key was returned. Fuel purchasing is outside this project.

business_objective: Coordinate verified service-address changes across the municipal services selected by a resident.

stakeholder_statements.text: A resident submits a service-address change request and identifies the municipal services that should receive the new address.
The service desk clerk checks whether the request contains the required evidence and returns it when something is missing. The evidence list has not been agreed.
For a complete request, the verification officer records whether the address evidence is accepted or rejected.
When the evidence is accepted, the department liaison sends the verified address change to each identified service and records each service's confirmation.
The request is closed after all identified services confirm the update. Property ownership changes are not part of this process.

business_objective: Track residential noise complaints, occupant responses, mediation actions, and case closure while preserving unresolved disclosure rules.

stakeholder_statements.text: A resident reports a repeated noise issue, identifies the affected unit, and may attach supporting notes.
The property officer checks the report, assigns a case category, and sends the complaint details to the occupant of the affected unit. The category list is still undecided.
The occupant says the complaint should include the reporter's identity so they can understand who raised it. The occupant may submit a response and supporting material.
The reporter expects their identity to remain hidden from the occupant. They should still be able to see whether the case is open, under mediation, or closed.

If the property officer sends the case to mediation, the mediation coordinator records the agreed actions and the building manager closes the case after those actions are marked complete. Nobody has decided who chooses the mediation coordinator, and the team spent time arguing about the lobby music.
